_about: Learning resources for the path planner (free ones preferred; the company funds paid ones). Every URL was opened on the retrieval date (WebFetch/curl). verified=true means the page loaded and the title and cost were checked; cost says free only where the provider states it (see cost_source); paid courses are allowed because the company funds training; verified=false needs a human check. hours_source says whether hours come from the provider page or are a team estimate (assumption). Prerequisites are the team's declared ordering. None are HRD Corp listings (hrd_claimable=false). Learning-plan fields (pathway.md §3.1) added 2026-10-23: skill_steps (from/to level on the 0 / 0.3 / 0.7 / 1.0 scale; to_level by the DECLARED rule on each skill's share of the course hours: at least half of to_basic reaches 'use sometimes' (0.7), at least to_basic + half of to_confident reaches 'confident' (1.0), otherwise 'heard of it' (0.3)), hours_basis, cost_myr / cost_type (free only where the provider says so; 'unknown' where no price is stated, which the plan never counts as free), hrd_claimable only with claim_evidence_url, eligibility, platform, format, delivery, certificate (null = not checked), language, tags, status (draft | verified; the demo shows verified only), last_verified, verified_by. The 26 courses checked on 2026-10-21 keep status verified (team decision 2026-10-23); their skills were re-mapped to the canonical vocabulary.
